name: precision_residual_confirm
description: Precision-Residual PhaseForge Confirmation (Professor Suggestion §4, §5, §10). Memoryless dual-stream policy: warm-started direct action base (partial_warm, drop_rate=0.5) + residual compliance branch (beta=0.0) + direct gripper head + unfrozen encoder (encoder_lr_scale=0.1) + margin prototype routing (margin=0.5, lambda_margin=0.05). Lipschitz and gain regularization disabled for baseline recovery. Gated on validation action MSE <= 0.032 before rollout evaluation.

methods.role: PhaseForge-direct control with SupCon + margin routing
